title: Sorceress with Dragon Orb
description: A hooded female sorceress with purple skin stands in the rain, holding a glowing orb containing a coiled dragon. She stands before a dark mountain range filled with glowing purple and green crystals, with a nest of glowing blue butterflies at her waist and a large magical purple sigil floating behind her head.
prompt: A hooded sorceress with purple skin and dark robes stands in heavy rain, holding a luminous orb with a golden dragon coiled inside. A glowing purple magical sigil floats behind her head. She stands before jagged dark mountains filled with glowing purple and green crystals. A nest of glowing blue butterflies rests at her waist. Atmospheric dark fantasy scene with dramatic lighting and rain.
